title: Visualise the Box
text:
When squares of side $x$ are cut from each corner:
- The original length (24 cm) loses $x$ from both ends: $24 - 2x$
- The original width (18 cm) loses $x$ from both ends: $18 - 2x$
- When folded up, the height becomes $x$

title: Volume Formula
text:
Volume of a rectangular box = length x width x height

$V = (24 - 2x)(18 - 2x)(x)$

title: Expand the Volume Function
text:
Expanding:
$(24-2x)(18-2x) = 432 - 48x - 36x + 4x^2 = 432 - 84x + 4x^2$

$V = x(432 - 84x + 4x^2) = 432x - 84x^2 + 4x^3$

Or: $V = 4x^3 - 84x^2 + 432x$

Note: Valid domain is $0 < x < 9$ (width must be positive)
